Merge PR #281: project-memory: add source sync interface skeleton

Merge Project Memory Source Sync Interface skeleton into dev/v2-start.

- Add ProjectMemorySourceSyncInterface skeleton for Stage 18
- Prepare candidate drafts from provided approved source payloads only
- Reject non-allowlisted source types, secret-like payloads, and raw-log-like payloads
- Export source sync interface through src/memory/index.js
- Add deterministic offline smoke coverage and focused smoke workflow

Boundaries: no live source fetching, no real sync, no DB reads/writes, no durable candidate writes, no confirmed memory writes, no auto-confirm, no AI calls, no Telegram, no runtime writes, no repo mutation from module, no env changes, no prompt injection.
